logline: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.

moments.description: Lady Juliana walks down the aisle expecting her wedding, but the haughty Matriarch chillingly tells her she should turn around because Gerald is not waiting for her anymore.
Lady Juliana approaches the altar in shock and watches in horror as Gerald holds hands with her sister, the Lady in Gold Gown, who smugly announces she is marrying him.
Lady Juliana breaks down and accuses Gerald of letting her walk down the aisle in her mother's gown, but Gerald coldly and callously admits he simply changed his mind.
Desperate for help, Lady Juliana drops to her knees and begs her elderly father, but he stubbornly stares at the floor and refuses to meet her gaze.
moments.key_dialogue: Tell them this is a mistake.

moments.description: The Matriarch and the Lady in Gold Gown cruelly demean Lady Juliana, with her sister viciously revealing that she is the daughter people only tolerate while her sister is the one they choose.
moments.key_dialogue: You are the daughter people tolerate because they have to.

moments.description: Gerald brutally discards Lady Juliana for her plainness and low value, prompting her tearful eyes to harden into cold, resolute defiance as strings swell to an ominous cliffhanger peak.
moments.key_dialogue: You have nothing to offer me anymore.
